Title: 495351-2026: France – Construction work – REDEVELOPMENT OF THE CLAUDIN LEJEUNE 3 BUILDING FOR THE INSA DIRECTORATE
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: Conversion of a university building (INSA) — university and campus projects are generally of interest for sbp. As this is a refurbishment in France (not DACH), the priority is somewhat lower.
titel: Conversion of the Claudin Lejeune 3 building for the INSA management
kurzbeschreibung: Conversion of a university building in several fit-out and technical lots in northern France.
umfang: Conversion or reorganisation of the Claudin Lejeune 3 building for the INSA management; execution in 5 lots with extended shell construction, interior fit-out, ceilings, joinery, parquet and painting works as well as electrical, fire protection and HVAC; execution period per lot 8 months. No information on GFA, structure, spans or construction volume.
leistungen: Construction works in 5 lots: extended shell construction; drywall, interior joinery and modular ceilings; parquet and painting works; heavy and low current as well as SSI; heating, ventilation and air conditioning.
relevanzbewertung_erklaerung:
• Pure construction execution without any recognisable link to design or structural design.
• University context is generally interesting, but here it is only conversion and fit-out trades.
• No information on complex structures, large spans or special constructions.
• Several lots concern interior fit-out and MEP, which does not match sbp’s core profile.
• Therefore only low strategic relevance for sbp.
baukosten_erklaerung: No construction costs stated in the notice. A reliable estimate is not possible due to the lack of GFA, depth of intervention, structural scope, quality standard and quantity assumptions. It is a building conversion in 5 fit-out and technical lots with 8 months construction time; a medium single- to low double-digit million volume would be roughly conceivable, but not reliable enough for a numerical indication.
honorar_erklaerung: No fee information available. As only construction works are tendered and no explicit design share is stated, an sbp-relevant fee cannot be reliably derived.
referenzen_qualifikationen: Suitability criteria according to the tender documents (DCE); not specified in detail in the notice itself.
auftraggeber: Université Polytechnique Hauts de France, Campus du Mont Houy, 59313 Aulnoy-lez-Valenciennes, France, e-mail: cellule-marches@uphf.fr, telephone: 0327511121, website: https://www.marches-publics.gouv.fr
notes: Open procedure for construction works with 5 lots; tenders to be submitted electronically via https://www.marches-publics.gouv.fr; language French; no framework agreement; notice classified as a competition, but in substance a contract notice for construction works.
